name: xploitscan-mcp

tools.name: scan_code
tools.description: Scan source code for security vulnerabilities using XploitScan's rules tuned for AI-generated code: the 30 free rules, or all 214 when this server is configured with a paid-plan XPLOITSCAN_API_KEY. Every result states which rule set ran; report that, not a rule count from memory. Returns a list of findings with rule ID, severity, file, line, description, and fix suggestion. Use this when the user asks you to check code for security issues, or before you write code to a file.

files.description: The files to scan. Pass an array of { path, content } objects — typically the files you just wrote or about to write.

path.description: File path relative to project root (e.g. 'src/api/login.ts'). Extension matters — some rules only apply to .ts/.tsx/.js/.jsx, etc.

content.description: Full source code of the file as a string.

tools.name: explain_rule
tools.description: Look up the description, severity, OWASP category, CWE, and remediation guidance for a specific XploitScan rule by its rule ID (e.g. 'VC005' for unprotected Stripe webhooks, 'VC006' for SQL injection). Use this when a user asks what a specific finding means or how to fix it. For a Pro rule when no paid XPLOITSCAN_API_KEY is set, only the OWASP/CWE mapping and a documentation link are returned.

tools.name: grade_code
tools.description: Scan code AND compute a security grade (A+ through F) with a score (0-100) and summary. Use this as a single-call 'is this code safe to ship' check — typically after generating a feature or before committing. The result states which rule set the grade is based on.

files.description: The files to grade. Same shape as scan_code's files parameter.
